limitations: This baseline establishes the cross-operator framework but does not demonstrate successful replication.
epistemic_firewall: Cross-operator agreement tests repeatability and robustness of the recorded research procedure; it does not establish truth, authorial intent, or confirmation of the GEI hypothesis. Agreement can increase reproducibility confidence without becoming substantive evidence. CONNECTED ≠ SUPPORTED ≠ CORROBORATED ≠ CONFIRMED.
notes: V1.0.16 baseline. Future operator runs must append new run states or a new version; they must not overwrite historical runs. Independent operators must preserve the V1.0.15 protocol and record deviations explicitly.
